A base of 175 gives 17.5. Consider a cursed rune: base 25, curse surcharge 12.5, first insurance 2.5 → 25 + 12.5 + 2.5 + 5 = 45 (integer). Keep searching systematically — an odd multiple of 25 in the base combined with a curse or high-enchantment surcharge on a 25-base component will produce quarters (e.g. .25 or .75).
